title: "Canada's Cattle Population" 
---

```{r}

library(htmltools)

cattle_page <- div(
  class = "project-container",
  
  # Hero Section
  div(
    class = "project-hero",
    img(
      src = "images/canadian_praires.png", 
      alt = "Cattle in Canadian landscape", 
      class = "hero-image"
    ),
    div(
      class = "hero-overlay",
      h1("Canada's Cattle Population"),
      p("Analyzing National Trends in Cattle Distribution and Farm Types")
    )
  ),
  
  # Project Context
  div(
    class = "project-context",
    h2("Background"),
    p(
      "This project analyzes data from ", 
      a(
        href = "https://doi.org/10.25318/3210013001-eng",
        target = "_blank",
        strong("Statistics Canada Table 32-10-0130-01")
      ), 
      " tracking the number of cattle by class and farm type across Canadian provinces and territories. /n",
      "Canada's cattle industry is a critical component of the agricultural economy, with significant ",
      "regional variations in herd sizes, farm types, and cattle classes. This analysis explores ",
      "these patterns to understand the distribution and evolution of cattle farming across the country."
    )
  ),
  
  # Objectives Section
  div(
    class = "project-objectives",
    h2("Goals"),
    tags$ul(
      tags$li("Visualize the geographic distribution of cattle across Canadian provinces and territories"),
      tags$li("Analyze trends in different cattle classes (beef cows, dairy cows, bulls, calves, heifers, steers)"),
      tags$li("Identify temporal patterns and changes in Canada's cattle population over time")
    )
  ),
  
  # Key Findings
  div(
    class = "project-findings",
    h2("Key Insights"),
    div(
      class = "findings-grid",
      div(
        class = "finding-card",
        h3("Regional Concentration"),
        p("Alberta and Saskatchewan dominate Canada's cattle industry, with the Prairie provinces accounting for the majority of the national herd")
      ),
      div(
        class = "finding-card",
        h3("Cattle Class Patterns"),
        p("Beef cows represent the largest cattle class, reflecting Canada's focus on beef production over dairy")
      )
    )
  ),
  
  # Tableau Dashboard
  div(
    class = "dashboard-section",
    h2("Interactive Dashboard"),
    a(
      href = "https://public.tableau.com/views/CanadasCattle/CanadasCattlePopulationDashboard?:language=pt-BR&:sid=&:redirect=auth&:display_count=n&:origin=viz_share_link", 
      target = "_blank",
      img(
        src = "images/cattle_dashboard_preview.png", 
        alt = "Canada's Cattle Population Dashboard Preview", 
        class = "dashboard-preview"
      ),
      p(class = "dashboard-link", "Click to view interactive dashboard on Tableau Public")
    )
  ),
  
  # Data Source Citation
  div(

    h2("Data Source"),
    p(
      strong("Citation: "), 
      "Statistics Canada. Table 32-10-0130-01 Number of cattle, by class and farm type (x 1,000)"
    ),

        href = "https://doi.org/10.25318/3210013001-eng",
        target = "_blank",
        "https://doi.org/10.25318/3210013001-eng"
      )
    ),
    p(
      strong("Release date: "), "2025-08-22"
    )
  ),
  
  # Skills Section
  div(

    div(
```
